title: Mixing: The Lovely Linda, That Would Be Something, Valentine Day, Momma Miss America, Oo You, Teddy Boy by Paul McCartney | 1970
content:
Studio Two, EMI Studios, Abbey Road
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Phil McDonald, John Kurlander

A mixing session for the McCartney album took place at Abbey Road on 24 January 1970.

They worked on six songs: ‘The Lovely Linda’, ‘That Would Be Something’, ‘Valentine Day’, ‘Momma Miss America’, ‘Oo You’, and ‘Teddy Boy’. ‘Momma Miss America’ had the working title ‘Momma’.

The mixes were for review and assessment purposes, and were never released.

Page last updated: 10 November 2025
